audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagreed with the whys under them. The rows read Skill / Yone / Yone / Skill / Skill / Yone / Yone, while whys[0], [2], [3] and [4] all said 'Warwick-favoured' and whys[1] said 'Skill'. The packet chart matches the whys.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1, so Warwick's Blood Hunt lets him walk Yone down in every window where the spirit is on cooldown; Yone only takes over once a crit or on-hit item lands.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 4 to Warwick and row 1 to Skill, as matched full/content pairs, with ratings raised on the Warwick rows and lowered on the two Yone rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why still sold Warwick's Blade of the Ruined King and two-item side lane on rows the chart gives to Yone.
audit.why: Yone's first crit/on-hit item is the earlier spike, and at two items Fate Sealed (120/100/80, 1000 range) pulls a whole line toward him while Soul Unbound repeats damage on return.
audit.corrected: Both whys re-keyed to Yone's items and to Fate Sealed's pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and late both said Soul Unbound rewinds Yone's 'position and health-state'. It does not restore health.
audit.why: Riot's description: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind and gains move speed; when the ability ends the spirit is forced back to the BODY and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit. There is no health restoration — a player told his E undoes damage taken will disengage at the wrong moment. Also unstated anywhere: Mortal Steel is a flat 4s and at 2 stacks dashes him forward with an airborne knockup, which is the thing that cuts Warwick's channelled R, and Spirit Cleave (14s) shields more for each champion it hits.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text and late now state the snap-back-to-body plus repeated damage; dosFull[0].d carries the 22s rank-1 cooldown and names the return as the R window; dontsFull[0].d states the two-stack dash knockup cutting R; dontsFull[1].d states the Spirit Cleave shield scaling with champions hit; dosFull[1].d states its 14s cooldown.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Soul Unbound's cooldown.
edits.after: His first crit or on-hit item pushes mixed damage past your Q heal — stop taking the long trade.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls your line in and his E repeats damage on return — carry threat 9/10, so engage from fog, not head-on.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. R-lock him there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — when it ends he is yanked back to his body. R him there.

edits.before: Q-bite Yone as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite as he steps up: Jaws heals for the damage dealt, and Spirit Cleave is 14s, so the second trade beats his shield.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks dash in and knock you up, cutting your R channel.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields more per champion it hits — fight him alone.

edits.before: With items Yone's E Soul Unbound lets him deal damage then rewind to full position and health-state, so he wins extended duels — pick him with R engage instead.
edits.after: With items Yone's E Soul Unbound lets him commit, then snaps his spirit back to his body and repeats part of the damage dealt — pick him with R engage instead.

edits.before: Once Yone completes an item his kit flips the matchup: E Soul Unbound rewinds his position and health-state after he commits, and crit-backed mixed damage overwhelms your Q heal. Play for R Infinite Duress engages from fog and let your team collapse rather than dueling.
edits.after: Once Yone completes an item his kit flips the matchup: E Soul Unbound snaps him back to his body and repeats a portion of the damage he dealt, and crit-backed mixed damage overwhelms your Q heal. Play for R Infinite Duress engages from fog and let your team collapse rather than dueling.

notes: Two fields claimed Soul Unbound rewinds Yone's 'health-state'. It returns his spirit to his body and repeats a portion of damage he dealt — it does not undo damage he took. That error tells the player to give up a winning trade. No mirror audit existed for this matchup.
